weld.surprise: The synergy neither parent predicts alone: that STACKING MANY LAYERS of the simple connectionist unit and training the whole stack by gradient descent yields EMERGENT, hierarchical, distributed REPRESENTATIONS that automatically discover features — making a single general architecture beat decades of hand-engineered, domain-specific, symbolic solutions across vision, speech, language, and games. Neither parent alone reaches it: the neural substrate alone (perceptron) is a SHALLOW classifier that provably cannot compute XOR (Minsky-Papert 1969); the optimization calculus alone is just curve-fitting. Only JOINTLY — a deep differentiable net + backprop gradient flow + (at consummation) enough compute and data — does 'representation learning' appear: the network learns WHAT to represent, not just how to weight fixed features. The DEEPEST surprise is a MEANING-FRAME shift: intelligence-as-explicit-symbol-manipulation (the rival symbolic paradigm's axiom) is displaced by intelligence-as-emergent-statistical-structure-in-a-trained-function. A SECOND-ORDER surprise sits on top: SCALING LAWS (Kaplan 2020) — loss falls as a smooth power law in compute+data+parameters — so the child's capability is PREDICTABLE from scale alone, a regularity neither parent nor even the 1986 welders anticipated. The META-SURPRISE for the schema is the R9 DECOUPLING-IN-TIME: surprise_confidence was already ~0.9 and the synergy was DEMONSTRATED WORKING (LeNet on real handwritten digits, deployed reading bank cheques, 1989) ~23 years BEFORE the child consolidated as the dominant paradigm (2012) — a maximally fertile, repeatedly-demonstrated weld that stayed unborn-as-paradigm through TWO winters for want of the instrument-parents.

weld.bits_note: QUALITATIVE ONLY — and here a NEAR-PRINCIPLED-NULL per R16, for a different reason than QG. But NO numeric bit value is asserted — the clean MDL delta is not cleanly computable here. NO bit values fabricated.

forcing_events.name: Minsky-Papert 'Perceptrons' (1969)
forcing_events._kind_note: fashion (intellectual-fashion redirection) with a politics/prestige amplifier — a KNOWLEDGE-frame critique that acted as a fashion+funding squeeze.
forcing_events.mechanism: A rigorous mathematical critique (single-layer perceptrons cannot compute XOR/parity) that, amplified by the authors' MIT prestige, redirected intellectual fashion and funding AWAY from connectionism toward symbolic AI — triggering the ~1969-1986 neural-net winter. A KNOWLEDGE-frame squeeze with a politics/prestige amplifier.

forcing_events.name: Symbolic-AI funding capture (mid-1960s)
forcing_events.mechanism: Symbolic-AI proponents (post-Dartmouth-1956) 'gained control of national funding conduits and ruthlessly defunded' the cybernetics wing — an institutional/political squeeze that 'liquidated' neural-net research for decades BEFORE Minsky-Papert formalized it.
forcing_events._confidence_note: The 'ruthlessly defunded' phrasing is from aggregator histories (~0.7); the directional fact (symbolic AI captured funding) is well-attested.

forcing_events.name: Mansfield Amendment (1969) + DARPA mission-orientation
forcing_events.mechanism: US legislation forced DARPA to fund 'mission-oriented direct research' with near-term military payoff, starving open-ended basic research; compounded by the 1974 cancellation of CMU's $3M/yr speech-understanding contract ('taught a lesson'). Acts THROUGH the DARPA actor.

forcing_events.name: Lighthill Report (1973, UK)
forcing_events.mechanism: Sir James Lighthill's survey for UK Parliament declared AI had failed its 'grandiose objectives' (combinatorial explosion); 'led to the complete dismantling of AI research in the UK' — the canonical broad-AI-winter trigger. NOTE: more symbolic-AI than neural-net-specific (a framework-vs-record nuance — acted weakly on the neural-net weld, strongly on the broad/symbolic field).

forcing_events.name: Lisp-machine market collapse (1987)
forcing_events.mechanism: Cheap general workstations (Sun/Apple/IBM) crossed the threshold to run Lisp, erasing a ~$500M specialized-hardware industry in one year (Symbolics bankrupt); collapsed confidence in the symbolic program — a squeeze on the RIVAL that, ironically, cleared space for connectionism's later rise (the anti-correlation: this squeeze on B was a pull on A).

forcing_events.name: DARPA 'deep and brutal' AI cut (1987-89, Jack Schwarz)
forcing_events.mechanism: New IPTO head Jack Schwarz dismissed expert systems as 'clever programming' and cut AI funding 'deeply and brutally'; he wanted DARPA to 'surf' waves not 'dog-paddle' and judged AI not the next wave — a leadership-driven funding squeeze.

forcing_events.name: Fifth Generation project failure (1981-1992, Japan)
forcing_events.mechanism: Japan's $850M MITI bet PULLED global AI funding in the early 1980s (defensive Western response: MCC, Alvey, ESPRIT) then SQUEEZED confidence when it ended 'with a whimper' in 1992 having missed its goals. A both-direction event on the RIVAL paradigm. Acts through the MITI actor.

forcing_events.name: Kernel-methods/SVM fashion wave (mid-1990s-2000s)
forcing_events.mechanism: Support vector machines and kernel methods had cleaner theory and beat nets on the era's small data + weak compute, making neural nets unfashionable/unfundable — a FASHION-frame squeeze (not a theorem, not politics: the field's taste shifted). This is the 'Hinton's dark ages' (dormancy #2) driver.

forcing_events.name: CIFAR program (2004+) + Canadian state support
forcing_events.mechanism: A foundation/government PULL that deliberately funded and networked the marginalized connectionists (Hinton/Bengio/LeCun) during dormancy #2 — the institutional carrier that kept the wrapper alive until the instrument caught up. ('Neural Computation and Adaptive Perception' program, Hinton director, ~$2.5M/5yr.) Acts through the CIFAR actor.

forcing_events.name: NVIDIA CUDA / GPGPU (2007)
forcing_events.mechanism: General-purpose GPU computing made the matrix-multiply core of deep nets ~orders of magnitude cheaper; the gaming-GPU market (an exogenous consumer-tech driver) accidentally supplied the apparatus that GATED the 2012 weld. The PULL that un-stuck the rate-limited weld. Acts through the NVIDIA actor.

forcing_events.name: Big-data / internet-scale labeled data (2007-2012, ImageNet + Mechanical Turk)
forcing_events.mechanism: The web + crowd-labor platforms (Amazon Mechanical Turk) made 14M-image labeled datasets feasible — an exogenous data-economy driver that supplied the second gating instrument. Acts through the Fei-Fei Li actor.

forcing_events.name: Post-2012 AI investment + hype boom
forcing_events.mechanism: A fashion+capital PULL ($50B 2022 -> projected $364B 2025; 800k US job openings 2022; ChatGPT 100M users in 2 months) that accelerated the consolidated child into hegemony — the mirror image of the earlier squeeze events.

forcing_events.name: 2018 Turing Award + 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics
forcing_events.mechanism: Elite institutional recognition (ACM, Nobel committee) consolidated and CANONIZED deep learning — but triggered re-attribution disputes (Schmidhuber: the Nobel 'rewards plagiarism'); a cultural-consecration pull that doubles as a re-attribution event (cross-references discrepancies[1] and the reattribution{} field).

_schema_gaps_in_record: GRANULAR MULTI-DORMANCY: the schema's single dormancy_intervals + revival can't cleanly hold TWO nested winter-cycles WITH different why_frames (1969-86 knowledge+politics squeeze; 1995-2006 fashion+insufficient-instrument) AND a contested-dormancy revisionist overlay (Haigh). Needs R11 (dormancy.why_frame) applied PER-INTERVAL (done here) AND a dormancy.contested flag (not in the schema — worked around via discrepancies[2] + fuzzy_layer.frontier).

ANTI-CORRELATED RIVAL FORTUNES: no field expresses 'this weld's winter is its RIVAL's spring' (connectionism rose 1986-89 exactly as symbolic AI's second winter began; symbolic AI's 1987 collapse cleared its space). pre_weld_relationship=antagonism (R14) captures the rivalry but NOT the INVERSE-PHASE dynamic between the two paradigms' lifecycles. PROPOSED new variable: rival_lifecycle_coupling (a signed phase-relation between two welds' lifecycles). Worked around here via relatives[rel-symbolic].note + forcing_events[fe-lisp-collapse] (a squeeze on B that pulled A).

INSTRUMENT-PARENT AS RATE-LIMITER: the 2012 weld needed compute (NVIDIA/CUDA) and data (ImageNet) as INSTRUMENT-parents that are not ideas. R4 (parent_kind=instrument) covers the TAG, but this specimen shows an instrument-parent can be the GATING/rate-limiting parent (the algorithm waited ~23 years for it). PROPOSED: a parent_is_gating / rate_limiting boolean distinct from merely tagging the kind. Worked around via parents_full[par-compute]._parent_kind_note + the instrument-enabled-weld type weight.

DEMONSTRATED-NOT-ADOPTED state: R15 (surprise_priority) covers 'conjectured early', but here the surprise was repeatedly DEMONSTRATED working (LeNet 1989, deployed on bank cheques) yet not ADOPTED as paradigm for ~23 years for want of scale. The gap between technical proof and paradigm consolidation (ADOPTION-LAG) is its own variable, STRONGER than conjecture-lag. PROPOSED: a surprise-state value 'demonstrated-not-adopted' + an adoption_lag field. Worked around via surprise_priority (with 'demonstrated working' noted) + discrepancies[4].

INSTITUTIONAL CARRIER-THROUGH-DORMANCY: D2 carrier role is well-supported, but the specific pattern 'a FOUNDATION/STATE deliberately funds a marginalized wrapper through its winter to keep it alive' (CIFAR) is a distinct actor-function worth a NAMED ROLE (flame_keeper / dormancy_patron) beyond generic carrier_of. Worked around via actors[act-cifar].relation='carrier-through-dormancy' + _role_note.

FRAME-OWNERSHIP CONTEST: the 2024 Nobel shows the SAME child claimed by physics / CS / cognitive science — D3's physical/latent straddle plus a WHICH-KNOWLEDGE-FRAME-owns-it dispute. The schema can tag frame[] but has no slot for CONTESTED frame-ownership (which discipline's frame the weld 'belongs' to), relevant where consecration/credit follows frame-ownership. Worked around via discrepancies[7].
